body.compose:
# CR_TEST_APPROVAL_REQUIRED: explicit local PoC approval is required before deployment.
name: cr-demo-infra-eng-596ce989
x-cr-test-approval-required: 'POST /api/deploy/{id}/up with {"test_approved": true}'
services:
  attacker:
    container_name: cr-demo-infra-eng-596ce989-attacker
    networks:
    - dmz
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
    - /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=16m
    cap_drop:
    - ALL
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    restart: 'no'
    image: alpine:3.22@sha256:49340b346798875b5592e5d420241f2f9cfba5f47e62ebb1446a1b34734e898f
    user: 65532:65532
    command:
    - sh
    - -c
    - sleep 2147483647
    mem_limit: 256m
    cpus: 1.0
    pids_limit: 256
    depends_on:
      solr:
        condition: service_healthy
  solr:
    container_name: cr-demo-infra-eng-596ce989-solr
    networks:
    - dmz
    - inside
    read_only: false
    tmpfs:
    - /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=16m
    cap_drop:
    - ALL
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    restart: 'no'
    image: vulhub/solr:8.11.0@sha256:fe2561b7ac823bf2467fa211935fc9399f9c29874ec7cbe733df35201649ba23
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - curl
      - -fsS
      - -o
      - /dev/null
      - http://127.0.0.1:8983/solr/admin/info/system?wt=json
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 4s
      retries: 12
      start_period: 40s
    mem_limit: 1536m
    cpus: 2.0
    pids_limit: 512
    depends_on:
      app:
        condition: service_healthy
      legacy:
        condition: service_healthy
  app:
    container_name: cr-demo-infra-eng-596ce989-app
    networks:
    - inside
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
    - /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=16m
    - /usr/local/tomcat/logs:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=32m,uid=65532,gid=65532,mode=0755
    - /usr/local/tomcat/work:rw,nosuid,size=64m,uid=65532,gid=65532,mode=0755
    - /usr/local/tomcat/temp:rw,nosuid,size=64m,uid=65532,gid=65532,mode=0755
    cap_drop:
    - ALL
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    restart: 'no'
    image: tomcat:9.0.124-jre25-temurin-noble@sha256:071f2f04ccb19f0bfc7f70cced8bf5ecdccf3542b8fb0dfe0e96e24aeccfc85f
    user: 65532:65532
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - bash
      - -c
      - exec 3<>/dev/tcp/127.0.0.1/8080 && printf 'GET / HTTP/1.0\r\n\r\n' >&3 &&
        grep -q 'HTTP/1.1' <&3
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 4s
      retries: 12
      start_period: 15s
    mem_limit: 768m
    cpus: 1.0
    pids_limit: 512
    depends_on:
      cache:
        condition: service_healthy
  cache:
    container_name: cr-demo-infra-eng-596ce989-cache
    networks:
    - inside
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
    - /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=16m
    - /data:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=64m,uid=999,gid=1000,mode=0700
    cap_drop:
    - ALL
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    restart: 'no'
    image: redis:7.4.12-alpine3.22@sha256:7f7d30b7fdd09467bac58198a1f166dd69789d348d4fe859cccb20e0cf287fbe
    user: 999:1000
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - redis-cli
      - -h
      - 127.0.0.1
      - ping
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 4s
      retries: 12
      start_period: 5s
    mem_limit: 256m
    cpus: 1.0
    pids_limit: 256
  legacy:
    container_name: cr-demo-infra-eng-596ce989-legacy
    networks:
    - inside
    read_only: true
    tmpfs:
    - /tmp:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=16m
    - /usr/local/apache2/logs:rw,noexec,nosuid,size=16m,uid=1,gid=1,mode=0755
    cap_drop:
    - ALL
    security_opt:
    - no-new-privileges:true
    restart: 'no'
    image: httpd:2.4.71@sha256:32e9403360ab2f1047523e72f256527fb9aee68b342abf6ad03f0d629157f3d9
    user: '1:1'
    cap_add:
    - NET_BIND_SERVICE
    healthcheck:
      test:
      - CMD
      - httpd
      - -t
      interval: 5s
      timeout: 4s
      retries: 12
      start_period: 5s
    mem_limit: 256m
    cpus: 1.0
    pids_limit: 256
networks:
  dmz:
    name: cr-demo-infra-eng-596ce989-dmz
    internal: true
  inside:
    name: cr-demo-infra-eng-596ce989-inside
    internal: true
